verdict.rationale: MoonPay is a hosted payments and KYC service that stores customer payment and identity data, so data-residency choice is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any option to choose a storage region or residency location. The closest items cover PCI-hosted card capture and stored payment methods, which are unrelated to residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
